hints.content: The hanger has equal weight on each side. Let's start by writing an expression for the weight on each side.

The left side of the hanger has $2$ weights, each of which weighs $\purpleC{a}$ units.  

The left side of the hanger weighs $\purpleC{a}+\purpleC{a}$ units, which we can simplify to $2\purpleC{a}$ units.

The right side of the hanger has one weight which weighs $36$ units.

So, the hanger shows us $2\purpleC{a}=36$.

The weight labeled $\purpleC{a}$ weighs $\dfrac{1}{2}$ as much as the $36$ unit weight.

$\purpleC{a}=\dfrac{36}{2}={}?$
